original.statement: The external-secrets v0.16.0 release notes record a dependabot chore that bumped the repository's CI dependency github/codeql-action from 3.28.12 to 3.28.13, which is a development-workflow change and not part of the product artifacts shipped to customer environments.

decision.reason: [ev-6d976955075b] only records a dependabot chore that bumps github/codeql-action from 3.28.12 to 3.28.13. Nothing in the evidence presents it as a runtime or deployment dependency of external-secrets. It reads as a repository build-tooling bump, so a product-relationship subject overstates what the evidence supports. No other subject family fits either. Three of the four proposers also left the subject and change undetermined, so no correct typed assertion follows from this evidence.
